items.signal: Texans WR Jaylin Noel questionable to return vs the Giants with a toe injury.
items.why: In-game injury; no diagnosis yet.
items.implication: Small shift in Texans WR targets if Noel misses time.
items.opportunity: Monitor postgame update; low fantasy impact.

items.text: J.J. McCarthy has a chance right now to be a hero. Giants get the ball, tie game, 52 seconds remaining. He's been great so far today.
items.signal: McCarthy was 16 of 23 for 231 yards in the 4th quarter and the Giants won 27-21 in overtime vs Houston.
items.why: Strong passing day from a QB on JD's waiver board.
items.implication: Bumps McCarthy as a QB streaming option.
items.opportunity: Keep on the QB watch list; verify Yahoo availability before any claim, which Billy must approve.

items.text: Bijan Robinson has hit the 700-yard mark this season on the ground. He is the first #Falcons running back with 700 or more rushing yards through seven games of a season since Warrick Dunn in 2005.
items.signal: Bijan Robinson passed 700 rushing yards on the season in the Falcons' 29-20 win over the 49ers.
items.why: Confirms his workhorse role.
items.implication: No change; Bijan remains a locked-in JD starter.
items.opportunity: Hold.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially active vs Raiders despite calf injury. Earlier optimism reported he was feeling better Saturday with no setbacks expected.
items.why: Calf minor per McVay; felt better Saturday.
items.implication: Full or near-full WR1 role expected in high-total game vs LV.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets as primary; monitor snap share early.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey went to locker room then returned during game (thigh issue noted in related reports).
items.why: Thigh; left then returned.
items.implication: Monitor remaining snaps/usage; 49ers WR injuries already thinning targets.
items.opportunity: Continued three-down if healthy; possible reduced if limited.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially inactive. Earlier sources said unlikely after quad strain, not full participant, may have worked out but too early.
items.why: Quad strain; missed three games; limited practice.
items.implication: Jets backfield to committee/backup lead vs MIA.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/snaps for backup RBs (e.g. Allen if primary).

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT in Sunday morning summary after prior QUESTIONABLE status. Tyler Huntley expected to start again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; third straight miss; was close but team cautious.
items.implication: Ravens offense limited; Huntley start impacts Ravens pass catchers and rushers volume/efficiency.
items.opportunity: Potential slight uptick for Zay Flowers/Henry/Andrews in volume but lower ceiling without Lamar dual-threat.

items.text: Sunday AM summary: Puka GTD/optimism; Breece GTD/pessimism; Jacobs/Coleman/Kirk/Mason/Dell/Sampson IN; Saquon expected; Lamar/Smith/Wicks OUT. Projections updated.
items.why: Aggregated weekend reports.
items.implication: Direct opportunity shifts for listed players and handcuffs.
items.opportunity: Inactives create clear backup roles; actives restore prior shares.

items.text: All ETR projections updated to reflect latest news (Lamar out, Puka optimism then active, Breece pessimism/inactive, etc).
items.why: Latest injury reports incorporated.
items.implication: Use updated numbers for start/sit/DFS.
items.opportunity: Reflects role changes from statuses.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY in weekend summary (questionable but expected). DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT for MNF.
items.why: Hamstring; back at practice; Q but expected per reports.
items.implication: Lead back role vs DAL if active; Eagles pass game thinned with Smith/Wicks out.
items.opportunity: Carries/red-zone for Saquon; targets to Goedert/other WRs with Smith/Wicks out.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs activated and expected to play Sunday. Listed IN by ETR.
items.why: Activated from exempt list.
items.implication: Lead or significant RB role return for GB vs DET.
items.opportunity: Carries/goal-line; monitor split with other backs post-layoff.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks ruled out for Monday Night vs Cowboys.
items.why: Injuries per beat/Tim McManus.
items.implication: Thinned Eagles WR corps for MNF; more targets to remaining pass catchers if Saquon active.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Goedert and secondary WRs.

items.text: Jonah Coleman should be rostered in 100% of leagues; by end of year the Broncos RB you wish you had. Activated/IN and expected to play.
items.why: Long-term breakout potential; activated from IR.
items.implication: Immediate roster/add priority; potential committee or lead role.
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps in Broncos backfield vs ARI.

items.text: Puka Nacua high in top-10 overall Week 7 rankings (noted around 3); confirmed active. Faith despite limited practice.
items.why: Matchup/usage faith; calf minor.
items.implication: Start with confidence in late window.
items.opportunity: Primary target share.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle), Puka Nacua (calf), Breece Hall (quad) statuses crucial to Sunday DFS main slate. Sneaky scratches include Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Brian Robinson, Jahwar Jordan. Projections updated on latest news. Tempted by CMC slot amid 49ers WR outs despite usual skepticism on RB-as-WR.
items.why: Key DFS pivots; sneaky outs create opportunity; 49ers WR dire situation.
items.implication: Adjust projections/lineups on finals; CMC receiving upside possible.
items.opportunity: Backup RBs/WRs on outs; CMC routes if lined up slot.
items.conflict: Rarely buys RB-as-WR hype but tempted here.

items.text: Broncos CB Pat Surtain II officially inactive (ankle); unlikely earlier, good chance next week. Matchup implication for ARI pass game.
items.why: Ankle; missed prior games.
items.implication: Softer coverage for Cardinals WRs.
items.opportunity: Slight upgrade routes/targets efficiency for ARI pass catchers.

items.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield active.
items.why: Thumb; returned.
items.implication: TB offense at full QB strength; helps WRs despite Egbuka out.
items.opportunity: Stable passing volume.

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo expected back as lead back.
items.why: Per Insiders report.
items.implication: Primary carries for NYG vs HOU.
items.opportunity: Snap share/carries/red-zone as lead.

items.text: Tyler Warren among sneaky important scratches/OUTs some may have missed.
items.why: Groin; listed OUT in ETR summary.
items.implication: Colts TE targets elsewhere; Indy pass game adjustment.
items.opportunity: Other Colts pass catchers (Pittman/Downs/Pierce) volume up.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka OUT (concussion/foot). Noted as sneaky important scratch by Levitan.
items.why: Concussion/foot.
items.implication: TB WR depth thinned; opportunity for other Bucs receivers.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for remaining WRs like Godwin if active.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love OUT. Bam Knight expected to lead ARI backfield with significant role for others.
items.why: Injury; ruled out.
items.implication: ARI RB committee shift vs DEN.
items.opportunity: Lead carries for backup (Knight etc).
